tools.name: search_public_research
tools.description: Search one published Charitology dataset. Preserves draft review states, source references and source-specific licensing. Depth classifications are hypotheses, not ratings.

tools.name: read_public_record
tools.description: Read an exact published record by its returned id, or exact source URL for bibliography records. Returns the original public fields and source rights; it never fetches the supplied identifier as a URL.

tools.name: read_public_coverage
tools.description: Read supported public dataset counts, descriptions, export dates and licensing limitations. Counts describe this published catalog, not complete charity or intervention coverage.
